message.content:
The most recent estimates put the United States’ Gini coefficient at roughly **0.41** (or 41 %) for the year 2022.  
This figure comes from the U.S. Census Bureau’s *Income Inequality* reports and is consistent with the World Bank’s 2023 estimate of 0.416 for the United States.  

> **Key points**  
> • The Gini coefficient ranges from 0 (perfect equality) to 1 (maximum inequality).  
> • A value of about 0.41 indicates moderate income inequality relative to many other OECD countries.  
> • The figure is based on household income data collected in the American Community Survey (ACS) and adjusted for inflation.  

If you need the exact number for a specific year or a different source, let me know!
